description.zh:
待创建的消费者分组的ID。用于标识消费者分组，全局唯一。

取值说明如下：

- 字符限制：支持字母a\~z或A\~Z、数字0\~9以及下划线（_）、短划线（-）。
- 长度限制：1~60个字符。

保留字符限制，请参见[参数限制](~~440347~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the consumer group that you want to create. This ID is used to identify the consumer group and must be globally unique.

The value must meet the following requirements:

- The ID can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

- The ID must be 1 to 60 characters in length.

For more information about reserved characters, see [Parameter limits](~~440347~~).

description.zh: 待创建的消费者分组所属的实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the instance to which the consumer group belongs.

descriptions.zh: ><notice>阿里云提供的OpenAPI属于管控类API，用于管理和查询阿里云服务的相关资源。仅推荐在管控链路集成，消息收发的核心数据链路中严禁依赖OpenAPI实现，否则可能会导致链路产生风险。></notice>
descriptions.en:
><notice>

The Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI is a management API used to manage and query Alibaba Cloud service resources. Integrate this API for management purposes only. Do not use this API for core data links that send and receive messages. This can introduce risks to your data links.

></notice>
